```{r}
parse_num_safe <- function(x) {
  readr::parse_number(as.character(x), na = c("", "NA", "Unreliable", "Not Applicable"))
}

clean_year <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    # rename residence columns to match old schema if they exist
    rename(any_of(c(
      "Census Region"      = "Residence Census Region",
      "Census Region Code" = "Residence Census Region Code",
      "State"              = "Residence State",
      "State Code"         = "Residence State Code"
    ))) %>%
    mutate(
      # standardize Year type across files
      Year_raw  = as.character(Year),
      Year      = readr::parse_number(Year_raw),
      Year_note = str_squish(str_remove(Year_raw, "^\\d{4}")),

      # types
      `Year Code`         = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Deaths              = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population          = parse_num_safe(Population),
      `Crude Rate`        = parse_num_safe(`Crude Rate`),
      `Age Adjusted Rate` = parse_num_safe(`Age Adjusted Rate`),

      # also standardize State Code to 2-digit character (helps later joins)
      `State Code` = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(`State Code`))
    )
}
```

```{r}

  filter(`Year Code` < 2018)
N172018 <- read_csv("Data/regionN172018.csv")

N17 <- bind_rows(

) %>%

glimpse(N17)
```

### Map
```{r}
period_map <- function(y) {
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(y))
  dplyr::case_when(
    y >= 2010 & y <= 2019 ~ "pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
    y >= 2020 & y <= 2022 ~ "pandemic (2020–2022)",
    y == 2023             ~ "transition (2023)",
    y >= 2024 & y <= 2025 ~ "post-pandemic (2024–2025)",
    TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
  )
}

```

```{r}
prep_state_period_aar <- function(df, outcome_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      period = period_map(`Year Code`)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
    group_by(State, period) %>%
    summarise(
      AAR = mean(`Age Adjusted Rate`, na.rm = TRUE),   # period mean of annual AAR
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome_label)
}

state_period_aar <- bind_rows(
  prep_state_period_aar(N17,    "AKI"),
  prep_state_period_aar(A40,    "Sepsis"),
  prep_state_period_aar(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")
)



```

```{r}
fi <- usmap::fips_info

state_period_aar_usmap <- state_period_aar %>%

    by = c("State" = "full")
  ) %>%
  rename(state = abbr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c(
        "pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
        "pandemic (2020–2022)",
        "transition (2023)",
        "post-pandemic (2024–2025)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(state, period, outcome, AAR)

```

```{r}
make_outcome_map <- function(df, outcome_name, low_col, high_col) {

  df_out  <- df %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)
  max_out <- max(df_out$AAR, na.rm = TRUE)

  plot_usmap(
    regions = "states",
    data    = df_out,
    values  = "AAR",
    color   = "grey60",
    size    = 0.2
  ) +
    facet_grid(period ~ .) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low      = low_col,
      high     = high_col,
      limits   = c(0, max_out),
      oob      = scales::squish,
      breaks   = pretty(c(0, max_out), n = 5),
      labels   = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1),
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust    = 0.5,
        barwidth       = unit(6, "cm"),
        barheight      = unit(0.6, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(outcome_name),
      subtitle = paste0("Scale: 0–", round(max_out, 0), " per 100,000"),
      fill     = "AAMR per 100,000"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", color = high_col),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", color = high_col),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid     = element_blank()
    )
}

```

### scatter plot
```{r}
prep_state_period_scatter <- function(df, outcome_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      period = period_map(`Year Code`),
      region = str_remove(`Census Region`, "^Census Region \\d+:\\s*")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
    group_by(State, period, region) %>%
    summarise(
      pop = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      AAR = mean(`Age Adjusted Rate`, na.rm = TRUE),   # period mean of annual AAR
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome_label)
}

```

```{r}
scatter_data <- bind_rows(
  prep_state_period_scatter(N17,    "AKI"),
  prep_state_period_scatter(A40,    "Sepsis"),
  prep_state_period_scatter(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")
) %>%
  mutate(
    period  = factor(period, levels = c(
      "pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
      "pandemic (2020–2022)",
      "transition (2023)",
      "post-pandemic (2024–2025)"
    )),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c(
      "AKI",
      "Sepsis",
      "AKI/sepsis"
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
library(usmap)

fi <- usmap::fips_info
if (is.function(fi)) fi <- usmap::fips_info()

scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
  left_join(fi %>% select(full, abbr), by = c("State" = "full")) %>%
  mutate(state_abbr = abbr)

scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
  mutate(label_ok = pop >= 5e6) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AAR), AAR > 0, pop > 0)

scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
  group_by(period, outcome) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_pop = rank(-pop, ties.method = "first"),
    rank_aar = rank(-AAR, ties.method = "first"),
    label_ok = rank_aar <= 15   # tune these numbers
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
avg_lines <- scatter_data %>%
  group_by(period, outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_AAR = mean(AAR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

p_scatter_better <- ggplot(

  aes(x = pop/1e6, y = AAR, color = region)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(
    data = avg_lines,
    aes(yintercept = mean_AAR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey40",

  )+ 

  geom_text_repel(
```

```{r}

plot_scatter_one_disease <- function(outcome_name) {

  df <- scatter_data %>%
    filter(outcome == outcome_name, !is.na(AAR), AAR > 0, pop > 0)

  al <- avg_lines2 %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  # ---- dynamic y-scale (per disease) ----
  # use observed range, padded a bit
  y_min <- min(df$AAR, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.90
  y_max <- max(df$AAR, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10

  ggplot(df, aes(x = pop/1e6, y = AAR, color = region)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.85) +

    # panel average line (per period)
    geom_hline(
      data = al,
      aes(yintercept = mean_AAR),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "grey40",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +

    # optional label for average (kept subtle)
    geom_text(
      data = al,
      aes(x = 0.6, y = mean_AAR, label = "Panel avg"),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = -0.4,
      size = 3,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +

    # label only selected states
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(df, label_ok),
      aes(label = state_abbr),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.15,
      point.padding = 0.10,
      segment.color = NA
    ) +

    scale_x_log10(
      name = "Population (millions, log scale)",
      breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +

    # ✅ adjusted y-scale (NOT starting at 0)
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Age-adjusted mortality rate per 100,000",
      breaks = pretty(c(y_min, y_max), n = 5),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max)) +

    # 4 periods inside ONE disease plot
    facet_wrap(~ period, ncol = 2) +

  

    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

```

### Table
```{r}

period_levels <- c(
  "pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
  "pandemic (2020–2022)",
  "transition (2023)",
  "post-pandemic (2024–2025)"
)

outcome_levels <- c("AKI", "Sepsis", "AKI/sepsis")

prep_state_period_rate <- function(df, outcome_label, rate_col = "Age Adjusted Rate") {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      period = period_map(`Year Code`),
      State  = str_squish(State)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period), !is.na(State)) %>%
    group_by(State, period) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = mean(.data[[rate_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome_label)
}

state_period_aamr <- bind_rows(
  prep_state_period_rate(N17,    "AKI",          rate_col = "Age Adjusted Rate"),
  prep_state_period_rate(A40,    "Sepsis",       rate_col = "Age Adjusted Rate"),
  prep_state_period_rate(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis", rate_col = "Age Adjusted Rate")
) %>%
  mutate(
    period  = factor(period, levels = period_levels),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = outcome_levels)
  )
```
```{r}
fi <- usmap::fips_info
if (is.function(fi)) fi <- usmap::fips_info()

all_states <- unique(fi$full) %>% setdiff("District of Columbia")

state_aamr_table <- state_period_aamr %>%
  filter(!is.na(State), State %in% all_states) %>%
  complete(
    State = all_states,
    period = factor(period_levels, levels = period_levels),
    outcome = factor(outcome_levels, levels = outcome_levels)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period_short = dplyr::recode(as.character(period),
      "pre-pandemic (2010–2019)"  = "Pre",
      "pandemic (2020–2022)"      = "Pandemic",
      "transition (2023)"         = "Transition",
      "post-pandemic (2024–2025)" = "Post",
      .default = NA_character_
    ),
    col = paste0(as.character(outcome), "_", period_short)
  ) %>%
  select(State, col, AAMR) %>%
  # IMPORTANT: guarantee uniqueness BEFORE pivot
  group_by(State, col) %>%
  summarise(AAMR = mean(AAMR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = AAMR) %>%
  arrange(State)

state_aamr_table_pub <- state_aamr_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
state_aamr_table_pub
```

```{r}
make_ft <- function(df, font_size = 9) {
  flextable(df) |>
    theme_booktabs() |>
    fontsize(size = font_size, part = "all") |>
    padding(padding = 2, part = "all") |>
    autofit() |>
    align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
}

# Check your real column names first (optional)
# names(state_aamr_table_pub)

# If your columns are ARF_Pre, ARF_Pandemic, ARF_Transition, ARF_Post:
arf_tbl <- state_aamr_table_pub %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("State","AKI_Pre","AKI_Pandemic","AKI_Transition","AKI_Post")))

sep_tbl <- state_aamr_table_pub %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("State","Sepsis_Pre","Sepsis_Pandemic","Sepsis_Transition","Sepsis_Post")))

both_tbl <- state_aamr_table_pub %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("State","AKI/sepsis_Pre","AKI/sepsis_Pandemic","AKI/sepsis_Transition","AKI/sepsis_Post")))

doc <- read_docx()

doc <- body_add_par(doc,
  "State-level AAMRs by outcome and pandemic period (2010–2025)",
  style = "heading 1"
)

doc <- body_add_par(doc,
  "Values are age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMR) per 100,000, standardized to the 2000 U.S. standard population.",
  style = "Normal"
)

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "AKI (Renal failure)", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_ft(arf_tbl, font_size = 9))
doc <- body_add_break(doc)

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Sepsis", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_ft(sep_tbl, font_size = 9))
doc <- body_add_break(doc)

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "AKIF & Sepsis", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_ft(both_tbl, font_size = 9))

print(doc, target = "State_AAMR_Periods_Tables_Portrait.docx")



```
